changelog: Security: relations, meetings and the calendar are isolated per organization with `MT_ENFORCE_ISOLATION` off (#2542 follow-up). `scopeForRole()` (`src/lib/authzScope.ts`) now adds the caller's tenant to every role scope at the root, because the ADMIN builders returned `{}`, so a MARKETING admin's `GET /api/mentorship` listed the INTERNSHIP tenant's relations and mentee e-mails. `/api/meetings` (GET/POST), `/api/calendar-events`, the ICS feed and `/api/mentor/analytics` scope through the relation or project. `/api/mentor/email` is tenant-scoped and gated on `mentorship`. A meeting's tenant comes from its relation, then its project, then its conversation's project, then its creator (`src/lib/meetingTenantRule.ts`, unit-tested). `loadAccessibleMeeting`/`canManageMeeting`, series end and `/api/meeting-series` answer another tenant's row with 404. So do the relation timeline, transfer (`transferMentorship` now requires `callerOrgId`, and the incoming mentor must be in the relation's tenant), certificate, `mentor/mentees/[id]`, the person card, candidate bulk actions, duplicate merge, mentor suggestions, the relation-integrity report and the `/admin/re-engagement` page. New e2e: `e2e/tenant-isolation-relations.spec.ts`.

en: Each organization now sees only its own mentorships, meetings and calendar entries.
tr: Her kurum artık yalnızca kendi mentorluklarını, toplantılarını ve takvim kayıtlarını görüyor.
de: Jede Organisation sieht jetzt nur noch ihre eigenen Mentorings, Termine und Kalendereinträge.
